svg.aria-label: Looping dense ASCII gallery: a knight sits on a rock hugging his planted sword while a quill writes rest, write, train, repeat; two koi circle a pond; El waves from his rock; his greatsword planted in the rock with his cape snapping in the wind; a campfire save point; Merlin the flaming skull mage, talking.
